short: Akiva Benav is a Functional Integrative Medicine Practitioner specializing in Nervous System Regulation. He helps clients with stress and anxiety, gut and digestive issues, sleep problems, and fatigue through telehealth-based programs in nervous system regulation, gut–brain work, and breathwork therapy.
certs: NBC-HWC (National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach), IFM (Institute for Functional Medicine)
training: Master's in Nervous System Regulation from the Functional Integrative Medicine Institute; certification through the IFM and NBHWC, alongside advanced coaching certifications.
pricing: Programs are priced after your assessment. Apply at akivabenav.com for details.
long: Akiva Benav is a Functional Integrative Medicine Practitioner specializing in Nervous System Regulation. He helps clients with stress and anxiety, heart rhythm and palpitations, gut and digestive issues, sleep problems, fatigue, and stress-related weight patterns through telehealth-based programs in nervous system regulation, gut–brain work, and breathwork therapy. Sessions in English, Spanish, and Portuguese. Telehealth only, by appointment. Apply at akivabenav.com.
size: Solo telehealth practice, Monday–Thursday. Small client roster by design — a limited number of clients at a time.
